dedupeText: 90s sports collage aesthetic basketball grunge collage 90s aesthetic vibrant halftone distressed high contrast color blocking against monochrome crowd photography rough hand painted lettering interacting with clean typewriter text layered transparency between sports equipment silhouettes and background gradients dynamic diagonal movement created by logo placement and text flow combine a 2x2 primary color grid with halftone sports imagery and a mix of raw brush lettering and mechanical typewriter fonts

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-layered collage featuring a four-quadrant color split with distressed textures, halftone patterns, and bold, hand-painted style typography overlaid on sports-themed imagery.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking against monochrome crowd photography
Rough, hand-painted lettering interacting with clean typewriter text
Layered transparency between sports equipment silhouettes and background gradients
Dynamic diagonal movement created by logo placement and text flow
coreInvariants: Four-quadrant color division (Red, Blue, Yellow, Black)
Halftone screen textures on photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large hand-painted text dominates the center and bottom right; secondary text occupies the top left and center right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large green 'GO' in the top-center quadrant acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern: starts at top-left typewriter text, moves through the central green lettering, down to the bottom-left logo, and finishes at the bottom-right crowd scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'maximalist' with overlapping textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Primary Red and Cobalt Blue define the background quadrants.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow and Black provide high-contrast zones for text legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Kelly Green for the largest hand-painted glyphs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all quadrants with deep black shadows in the photographic layers.

letterConstructionRules: Main display text uses thick, irregular brush strokes with jagged edges
Secondary text uses a fixed-width slab-serif with distressed ink-bleed effects
Logo-style text uses heavy block letters with 3D extrusions and sharp outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation points are oversized and gestural
O's are rendered as rough, circular brush loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive contrast between raw, gestural brushwork and rigid, mechanical typewriter forms.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mechanical, slab-serif secondary text feel.
Approximates the raw, hand-painted energy of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid collage. Top-left: red gradient with a basketball hoop silhouette. Top-right: blue gradient with a basketball player halftone. Bottom-left: red/orange gradient with a basketball texture. Bottom-right: black and white high-contrast crowd scene with yellow overlay. Apply a heavy grunge and halftone texture across the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bright green hand-painted brush lettering in the center and bottom right. Add small white typewriter-style text in the top left and center right with a subtle black outer glow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the color split distinct into four quadrants?
Does the green text look hand-painted with rough edges?
Is the typewriter text distressed and monospaced?
Are there visible halftone patterns in the photographic elements?

postGenerationChecks: Verify no legible trademarked names are present
Ensure the green text is the most prominent visual element
Check that the typewriter text has an 'ink-bleed' effect
Confirm the four-quadrant layout is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 2x2 primary color grid with halftone sports imagery and a mix of raw brush-lettering and mechanical typewriter fonts.
